_description: One document per landmark or POI. Each document also acts as the parent for its geofence trigger. Copy this structure into FlutterFlow > Firestore > Create Collection.

name.note: Display name shown in the app card

slug.note: URL-safe lowercase ID; also used as Radar.io geofenceTag

coordinates.note: Use Firestore GeoPoint type — NOT a plain String

geofence_radius_metres.note: Always 40 for standard POIs; 100 for dismount zones

short_description.example: Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece — the most visited monument in Spain.
short_description.note: Max 160 chars; shown in notification body

long_description.example: Construction began in 1882 and is expected to complete in 2026...

audio_url.note: Firebase Storage URL for the audio guide track

getyourguide_affiliate_url.note: Affiliate deep-link for upsell CTA button

regulatory_alert.note: Only set for locations that carry legal warnings on entry

message.example: Gothic Quarter dismount zone — cycling prohibited. Fine: €500.

priority.note: high = full-screen takeover notification on iOS/Android

is_active.note: Set false to hide without deleting

_example_document.name: Sagrada Família
_example_document.short_description: Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece — the most visited monument in Spain.
_example_document.long_description: Construction began in 1882. Architect Antoni Gaudí took over in 1883 and worked on it until his death in 1926. Expected completion: 2026.
